numbers.title: गिनती (Numbers)
numbers.instruction: Have students count aloud with the teacher, pointing to objects as they count.

greetings.title: अभिवादन (Greetings)
greetings.instruction: Practice these greetings in pairs, taking turns.

objects.title: वस्तुएं (Common Objects)
objects.instruction: Point to each object in the classroom as you say its name.

animals.title: जानवर (Animals)
animals.instruction: Show pictures of each animal and have students repeat the name.
